claims.text: Supportive care for rhinosinusitis: nasal saline sprays
claims.quote: supportive care, which includes nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs for pain, nasal saline sprays, mucolytics such as guaifenesin, intranasal glucocorticoids, oral decongestants such as pseudoephedrine, and topical nasal vasoconstrictors (phenylephrine or oxymetazoline)
